original: 近所に新規オープンしたコンビニで買い物したらさ、粗品で食パンもらったんだ。

en.text: I went shopping at the new convenience store that opened in the neighborhood and received a free gift of bread.

original: 近所におもちゃ屋があります。

en.text: There is a toy shop in the neighborhood.

original: 近所の神社の境内には、樹齢800年といわれる銀杏の大木がある。

en.text: There's a large gingko tree that's said to be 800 years old inside the grounds of a nearby shrine.

original: 近所に激安スーパーがあればなあ。

en.text: I wish there were a super discount supermarket in the neighbourhood.

original: 数年前、近所の空き地で白骨死体が発見された。

en.text: Several years ago, a bleached body was discovered in a vacant plot in the neighbourhood.

original: 彼女は家の近所に住んでいるが、たまにしか会わない。

en.text: Although she lives in my neighbourhood, I only rarely meet her.

original: この近所を夜歩くのは不安だ。

en.text: I don't feel comfortable walking around here at night.

original: それは近所のどこかにあると僕は思うよ。

en.text: I think it's somewhere around here.

original: 僕は君とトムの近所に住んでいます。

en.text: I live near you and Tom.

original: 「私は彼をよく知ってるよ。近所の人なんだ」と彼女は言いました。

en.text: "I know him well, he’s from the neighborhood,” she said.

original: ちょうど2～3日前、近所のレストランでギリシャ料理を食べたんだ。

en.text: I ate some Greek food at a nearby restaurant just a few days ago.

original: 近所の人が風鈴を外してくれるといいのにな。

en.text: I wish my neighbors would get rid of their wind chimes.

original: 近所の人には知られたくないんだよ。

en.text: I don't want the neighbours to know about it.
I don't want my neighbors to know.
I don't want my neighbors to know about it.

original: 近所の家の多くに柿の木があるんです。

en.text: Many of my neighbors have persimmon trees.

original: 彼は近所に住んでいるんだ。

en.text: He lives close by.

original: 近所同士で助け合っています。

en.text: Neighbors help each other.

original: 近所の人たちは家の売却を余儀なくされた。

en.text: Our neighbors were forced to sell their house.

original: 彼女は家の近所に住んでいるのに、たまにしか見かけない。

en.text: Even though she lives in my neighborhood, we only occasionally see each other.

original: ジャクソン一家は、うちの近所に住んでるよ。

en.text: The Jacksons live in my neighborhood.

original: あれ近所の人の車ですよ。

en.text: That's my neighbor's car.
That car is our neighbor's.

original: 彼は近所に住んでいる。

en.text: He lives in the neighborhood.

original: この近所に引っ越そうと思ったきっかけは何ですか？

en.text: What made you decide to move into this neighborhood?

original: 机の上には、お昼を用意する時間も余裕もなかったから、近所で買って来いという母親からのメッセージだけが残されていた。

en.text: The only thing on his desk was a note left by his mother telling him to go buy lunch in the neighborhood because she hadn't had the time to make it.

original: トムはうちの近所に住んでるのよ。

en.text: Tom lives in our neighborhood.

original: 近所の人って、うるさい？

en.text: Are the neighbours noisy?

original: 近所の者なんですが。

en.text: We're your neighbors.

original: 近所の人よ。

en.text: He's my neighbour.

original: ご近所の方を招待しました。

en.text: I invited the neighbours.
I invited our neighbors.
